parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A ball X has mass 240 g and moves in a straight line on a horizontal frictionless surface with
an initial speed of 16 m s^{-1}. The ball collides with a stationary ball Y that has mass 480 g. After
the collision, ball X is stationary, as shown in Fig. 2.1.
parts.question_text_latex:
A ball X has mass 240 g and moves in a straight line on a horizontal frictionless surface with
an initial speed of 16 m $s^{-1}$. The ball collides with a stationary ball Y that has mass 480 g. After
the collision, ball X is stationary, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text: Show that the speed v of ball Y after the collision is 8.0 m s^{-1}.
parts.question_text_latex: Show that the speed v of ball Y after the collision is 8.0 m $s^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:

ΔE_{K} = J
